description: Labelled prompt pairs for semantic-cache quality. For each pair, 'a' is a prompt whose answer is already cached and 'b' is a new incoming prompt. label 'hit': b is a true paraphrase of a, so serving a's cached answer for b is correct. label 'miss': a hard negative, b shares most of its words with a but asks something different, so serving a's answer would be wrong. Written by hand for this harness (customer-support and product questions of a generic SaaS / online shop); no real company or customer data.
